task_completion.description: The lot is divided into at least three distinct named surface areas (rooms/zones).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three separate 'Room' or area labels in the 2D plan view with names like 'Plaza', 'Lawn', etc.

task_completion.description: At least two surface areas have distinct floor colors or textures applied.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 3D view or 2D plan, verify that at least two areas have different visual patterns (e.g., grass texture vs. stone paving).

task_completion.description: The park includes at least 12 vegetation items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the number of trees, plants, or flower beds in the 3D view or the object list sidebar; there must be 12 or more.

task_completion.description: The park includes at least 6 public seating items and 4 outdoor lights.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify benches/chairs (min 6) and lamp posts/bollards (min 4) in the 3D rendering or the furniture list.

task_completion.description: At least two dimension lines are placed to document sizes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for measurement lines with numerical values (e.g., '20.00 m') placed in the 2D plan view.

task_completion.description: The project is saved to the specific file path ~/Documents/SweetHome3D/pocket_park_final.sh3d.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save As' dialog box with the correct file path or the filename appearing in the application title bar.

task_completion.description: A 3D presentation image is rendered to ~/Documents/SweetHome3D/park_presentation.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Create photo' dialog box being used and the final output path set to park_presentation.png.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the park rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the Sweet Home 3D furniture catalog, 2D plan, and 3D view.

integrity.description: The 3D presentation image is a genuine render of the designed park.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of the rendered image (park_presentation.png) must match the layout and assets visible in the 2D/3D workspace.

integrity.description: Furniture and areas were manually placed and configured.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the progression of items being dragged from the catalog into the workspace.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent starts with a file named 'city_block_starter.sh3d' which contains a 20m x 30m enclosure. The final score threshold for success is 70/100. The agent must use the Sweet Home 3D interface to perform the design tasks.
